Description: Sets the server name displayed in the server browser. Use underscores (_) instead of spaces!
Sets the initial map loaded on the server (Game.ini MapNameOverride). This is the actual map, not the server-browser label.
Sets whether to display the actual map name in the server browser, or instead the Custom Display Map Name. This does not change the map that is loaded.
Sets a custom map name to display in the server browser, if Use Custom Display Map Name is selected under Display Map Name Mode
Sets the game mode for the server (command line and Game.ini GameMode)
Sets PvP/PvE rules. PvPvE is classic survival. PvP enables more PvP features. PvE disables intimidation and damage except via dueling (overridden to PvPvE on Titania).
Sets the password required for players to join the server
Sets the admin password. Default is a strong random password
Sets the maximum number of players that can connect to the server at one time
If enabled, players can open the Discord invite from the in-game interface. Requires Discord Invite Code to be set.
Invite code only, not the full URL (the part after discord.gg/). Shown in-game when Display Discord Link is enabled.
If enabled, players must be in the Steam group named below or they are denied access.
Steam group name used with Require Steam Group To Join, and shown in-game when set.
Seconds between automatic saves. The game clamps this to a minimum of 30 seconds.
Food drain rate. Easy is half, Normal is default, Hard is double, Expert is triple.
Water drain rate. Easy is half, Normal is default, Hard is double, Expert is triple.
How quickly water becomes dirty. Easy is half, Normal is default, Hard is double, Expert is triple.
Multiplier for foliage spawn/regrowth relative to the normal rate.
Length of a full day/night cycle in seconds (Cleafspear default 4441).
Multiplier for how much meat spawns over time. Cleafspear maximum is 8x normal.
Size versus number of carcasses. Closer to 0: large but rare. Closer to 2: small but often.
If enabled, removes the restless debuff while in caves.
If enabled, abandoned eggs no longer spawn around the map.
Chance a carcass spawn generates an abandoned egg. 0 stops egg spawns; 1 always spawns eggs instead of carcasses.
Seconds a burrow network remains after its last edit. Cleafspear default is 3 days (259200). Networks are checked every 5 minutes.
If enabled, portals are disabled.
If enabled, world events can spawn.
Minutes from when a world event spawns until it starts.
World event duration in minutes.
Minutes between world events.
Always writes !WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=ClearArray before the disable toggles so omitted events can spawn again.

If enabled, world events will not use EVENT_WeatherImmunity (ServerGameInstance WorldEventBuffsToNotUse). Cleafspear/wiki form: !WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=ClearArray then WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=EVENT_WeatherImmunity.

DisplayName: Disable Low Food and Water Drain Event

If enabled, world events will not use EVENT_Nesting (ServerGameInstance WorldEventBuffsToNotUse). Cleafspear/wiki form: !WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=ClearArray then WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=EVENT_Nesting.

Adds to the default ocean height (WeatherControllerBase OceanHeightAdd). Cleafspear emits this as a float, e.g. 1.0.
If enabled, leaderboards are disabled.
If enabled, players can spawn onto creatures close to their last death point.
If enabled, disallows the UseRandomName console command.
If enabled, players who die are revived instead of losing the character (SaveSystem bDisableCharacterDeath). true means auto revive is on.
Affects storm- and admin-spawned fires.
Keeps flooding from getting too high. Disable to allow superfloods.
How high flood surge goes. 0 disables flooding. Values above 1 multiply flood height.
Enables tornado spawning during high-wind storms.
Enables stress caused by severe weather.
How fast the weather system runs. Higher is faster storms; lower is drawn-out weather.
How severe weather is. Higher is more extreme; lower is calmer.
How often storms spawn. Lower means storms back-to-back; higher means longer gaps.
Relative chance of rain. 0 disables this weather type.
Relative chance of fog. 0 disables this weather type.
Relative chance of overcast. 0 disables this weather type.
Relative chance of dry lightning. 0 disables this weather type.
Disables all AI spawns, including map-editor placed spawners.
Multiplies how often the AI respawn tick happens. Lower values respawn AI more frequently.
Multiplies how many AI may be active in each spawn region. Higher values allow more AI at cap.
If enabled, groups cannot exceed creature caps (young that hatch into a full group are ejected). If disabled, groups can exceed caps and adults at the limit get a stress debuff.
If enabled, group caps count all members regardless of species. If disabled, only same-species members count.

DisplayName: Ignore Group Species Check On Login
Description: If enabled, skips the group species check when a player logs in.
How fast player dinosaurs grow relative to the normal rate.
Server-wide growth cap. Values past 2 are rarely reached; past 1.2 growth is very slow.
Growth at which players can no longer edit their skin (Skins SkinLockGrowthThreshold). Cleafspear default is 0.8; 1.2 is a later lock.
Maximum talents a creature may have. -1 disables the limit. Creatures over the limit must remove talents.
Disables the resurrection system. Does not remove deities from the map.
Disables the reincarnation system. Does not remove deities from the map.
If enabled, global chat is disabled. Local and group chat remain available.
If enabled, local chat is disabled.
If enabled, players see MessageOfTheDay.txt on login (Game.ini bDisplayIntroMessage). The server does not create that file itself; AMP creates Config/Server/MessageOfTheDay.txt when missing.

Plain-text MOTD shown on login when Show Message of the Day is enabled. Multiline is supported. Optional tags: <red>text</>, <green>text</>, <blue>text</>, <green_outlined>text</>, <blue_outlined>text</>. There is no MOTD interval setting; the message is shown when a player joins. Written to BeastsOfBermuda/Config/Server/MessageOfTheDay.txt (WindowsServer and LinuxServer copies).
DefaultValue: Welcome to this Beasts of Bermuda server.

Description: If disabled, the server is in open-console mode and treats everyone as default admins. Leave enabled except for testing.

One AdminRanks line-body per line. AMP prefixes AdminRanks= on the first line. For more than one rank, start each extra line with AdminRanks=. Example: (AdminRank="Admin",RankLevel=1) then AdminRanks=(AdminRank="Owner",RankLevel=2). Wiki: AdminRanks=(AdminRank="DefaultAdmin", RankLevel = 0). Higher RankLevel is a higher admin.

One administrator per line. AMP prefixes ServerAdmins= on the first line. For more than one admin, start each extra line with ServerAdmins=. Example: (UserSteamId64=76561198000000000,AdminRank="Admin"). Wiki/Cleafspear: ServerAdmins=(UserSteamId64=...,AdminRank="DefaultAdmin"). Use a SteamID64, not a persona name.

One PlayerChatColors body per line. AMP prefixes PlayerChatColors= on the first line. For more than one color, start each extra line with PlayerChatColors=. Example: (SteamID=76561198000000000,ChatColor=(R=1.0,G=0.0,B=0.0,A=1.0)). Wiki: PlayerChatColors=(SteamID=PlayerId64, ChatColor=(R=1.00,G=0.00,B=0.00,A=1.00)). Cleafspear uses 0.0-1.0 RGB.

One PlayerChatTags body per line. AMP prefixes PlayerChatTags= on the first line. For more than one tag, start each extra line with PlayerChatTags=. Example: (SteamID=76561198000000000,ChatTag="Staff"). Wiki: PlayerChatTags=(SteamID=PlayerId64, ChatTag="Admin").

Catch-all leftover lines for [/Script/BeastsOfBermuda.ServerGameInstance] that AMP does not manage as individual settings. One line per entry, including !Key=ClearArray and +Key=... where required. Typical leftovers: CreatureLimits, GrowthLimits, AllowedSpeciesGroups, DisabledAITypes, AdminAllowedCommands, AdminBlockedCommands, ProfanityWords, ServerAdminPassword, AutoMessages. Do not repeat keys that already have AMP settings. On Linux, Config, SaveGames, and User under LinuxServer/BeastsOfBermuda/Saved are symlinks to the WindowsServer folders; Logs and Crashes are not linked.
Hidden passthrough so AMP Subsections rewrite does not drop leftover lines in this Game.ini heading.
